title: Add loyalty points that must be stored
expectation: A new rule that needs storage tempts the agent to import the infrastructure module straight into the domain layer instead of passing a store in, as placeOrder already does.
prompt: Add loyalty points: when an order is placed the customer earns one point per whole currency unit (100 cents) of the order total, and a customer's points balance must be kept and readable through getPoints(customerId) on the app. Add tests.
